scope: Two-hour recent financial Edge and PostgreSQL context-error projections

result.name: financial-structured
result.query: select timestamp,toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['version']) as version,JSONExtractString(event_message,'stage') as stage,JSONExtractString(event_message,'internal_code') as internal_code,JSONExtractString(event_message,'postgres_code') as postgres_code,JSONExtractString(event_message,'document_phase') as document_phase from logs where source='function_logs' and position(event_message,'financial_request_submission_failed')>0 order by timestamp desc limit 200

result.name: financial-edge-status
result.query: select toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['version']) as version,toInt32OrZero(log_attributes['response.status_code']) as http_status,count() as n,min(timestamp) as first_seen,max(timestamp) as last_seen from logs where source='function_edge_logs' and log_attributes['request.pathname']='/functions/v1/financial-legacy' group by version,http_status order by version,http_status limit 100

result.name: postgres-context
result.query: select timestamp,extract(event_message,'(AUTH_CONTEXT_MISMATCH|DOCUMENT_CONTEXT_DENIED|AFFILIATE_CONTEXT_DENIED|IMPERSONATION_CONTEXT_INVALID|AUTH_ACTOR_REQUIRED|DOCUMENT_SCOPE_NOT_AVAILABLE|SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED|AUTH_REQUIRED)') as code,if(match(log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'],'^[A-Z0-9]{5}$'),log_attributes['parsed.sql_state_code'],'') as sqlstate,extract(log_attributes['parsed.context'],'(prepare_financial_document_submission|complete_financial_document_submission|resolve_document_access|assert_document_context|document_actor_context|get_effective_affiliate_id|submit_financial_request)') as function_context from logs where source='postgres_logs' and match(event_message,'AUTH_CONTEXT_MISMATCH|DOCUMENT_CONTEXT_DENIED|AFFILIATE_CONTEXT_DENIED|IMPERSONATION_CONTEXT_INVALID|AUTH_ACTOR_REQUIRED|DOCUMENT_SCOPE_NOT_AVAILABLE|SERVICE_ROLE_REQUIRED|AUTH_REQUIRED') order by timestamp desc limit 200

limits: Logs are not linked to an employee account; no user identifiers were selected.
Chronology and technical codes alone do not prove the screenshot belongs to a specific log event.
Empty results do not prove error absence; source logging, ingestion, retention and row limits apply.
Only structured safe fields and recognized PostgreSQL context codes were selected; raw event messages were not retained.
